text:

title: Wonderful experience with Chema!
text:
Chema was a perfect guide for our day trip from Barcelona to the Dali Museum in Figueres and then the village of Girona. His knowledge of Dali brought the pieces in the museum alive and made the visit so much more enriching. On the way to Figueres he educated us on Dali’s life and friendship with Picasso. That really set the stage for enjoying the museum even more. 
After visiting the museum we drove to Girona, where he guided us to a lovely restaurant with Catalan specialties, Casa Mareita. The village and its history was fascinating. Again, Chema’s knowledge of history really made our visit

title: We had a great time on...
text: We had a great time on our day trip to Figueres and Girona! Our tour guide (Chema) was very knowledgeable and had first-hand experiences with each of these areas that gave the tour more story and context than simple facts. We recommend this tour if you want to see the areas outside of Barcelona.
